# Use TypeScript strict mode

`strict-typescript` · TypeScript compiler options `{"strict":true}`

Enable TypeScript's strict family of type-system checks.

I want compiler uncertainty to be surfaced rather than silently widened into permissive types. New strict checks introduced by TypeScript should become part of the default rather than requiring individual opt-in.
